what_it_is: CHEATS: All "Fun" But Play As Elvis, All "Gameplay", All "Weapons for Jo in Solo" But Farsight, All "Classic Weapons for Jo in Solo", All "Weapons" but Unlimited Ammo, Laptop Sentry Gun, All Guns in Solo For "Buddies"; Velvet Dark & Alien! Area 51 PA
format: DexDrive .n64: "123-456-STD" and a 0x1040-byte header (DexPlorer comments), then a 32 KiB Controller Pak: note NPDE/4Y "PERFECT DARK", 28 pages; ID block checksums 0101/FEFD

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/n64-dexdrive.py convert perfect-dark-2000.1704.n64 OUT: dexdrive: pak = the 32768 bytes after the 0x1040-byte header; ID block checksums 0101/FEFD wrong in every copy, rewritten as 0101/FEF1

converted_standalone.how: the same bytes as the .srm regions, as standalone Mupen64Plus keeps them: <GoodName (32 chars)>-<MD5 8>.eep/.sra/.fla/.mpk in its save folder

verified.baseline: with no save: Choose Your Reality lists only New Agent...
